switcher.title: Who’s using this?
switcher.emptyUsers: No users on this device yet. Ask the store owner to enroll this device.
switcher.idleLocked: Locked after sitting idle. Your work is safe.

pin.title: Enter your PIN
pin.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# more try left.} other {# more tries left.}}
pin.wait: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {duration}.
pin.lockedOut: The PIN was wrong too many times. Ask the store owner to unlock it in Settings, under Staff PINs.
pin.forgot: Ask the store owner to make you a new PIN. They can do it on this phone in Settings, under Staff PINs, even offline.

setup.title: Create a new PIN
setup.mismatch: The PINs don’t match. Start again.
setup.hint: 6 digits to sign in on this phone. Avoid your birthday.
setup.failed: The PIN couldn’t be saved. Try again.

change.title: Change PIN
change.wrongCurrent: That’s not your current PIN. Try again.
change.doneBody: From now on, sign in with the new PIN.

reset.noUsers: There’s no other staff on this phone yet.
reset.denied: Only a main owner can make a new PIN for another main owner.

unlock.confirm: {name} can sign in again right away with their old PIN.

manage.unauthorizedBody: Only the store owner can unlock or make PINs. Ask the store owner.

staff.title: Staff PINs
staff.handOverBody: {name} types their own new PIN, so you never see it.
staff.resetDoneBody: {name} can now sign in with the new PIN.
staff.unlockDoneBody: {name} can sign in again with their old PIN.
staff.lockedBody: The PIN was wrong too many times. Unlock it if {name} still remembers it, or make a new one.
staff.activeBody: The PIN isn’t locked. If {name} forgot it, make a new one.
staff.lockedUnlockBody: The PIN was wrong too many times. Unlock it if {name} still remembers it.
staff.lockedResetBody: The PIN was wrong too many times. Make a new one, typed by {name}.
staff.noPinBody: {name} has no PIN on this phone yet. Make one, typed by {name}.

pin.noPinBody: Ask the store owner to make one in Settings, under Staff PINs. You type the PIN yourself.

enroll.title: Enroll this phone
enroll.credentialsTitle: Sign in with the owner account
enroll.instruction: You only do this once per phone. It needs an internet connection.
enroll.storeTitle: Choose a store for this phone
enroll.nameDeviceFirst: Give this phone a name first.
enroll.needsConnection: Enrolling a phone needs an internet connection. Connect, then try again.
enroll.wrongCredentials: Wrong account name or password. Try again.
enroll.notOwner: This account can’t enroll phones. Sign in with the store owner’s account.
enroll.successNext: Next, choose who is using this phone.
enroll.discardMessage: What you entered will be lost.

revoked.title: Device Revoked
revoked.body: This device has been revoked and can no longer be used. Contact the store owner to enroll it again.
